title: MP Materials Corp. Quarterly Report for the period ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Q2 results include 840 metric tons of NdPr production, USD 108.5 million revenue and USD 20.3 million GAAP net loss; six-month capital expenditure was USD 307.7 million.
summary: The Q2 filing confirms segment economics, USD 1.453 billion of liquid resources, USD 934.6 million long-term debt carrying value, USD 428.1 million preferred liquidation preference, high capital expenditure, start-up costs and dilution relevant to the full valuation rebuild.
